title: Ball linear velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be v = 2Rω.

title: Force magnitude on ball
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be F = m√(4R²ω⁴ + g²).

title: Height of falling weight
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be h = (M + 16m)R²ω² / (2Mg).

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy (Mgh = ½Mv₁² + ½(4m)v²) for the system.

title: Force components analysis
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must resolve the rod force into centripetal (mv²/(2R)) and gravitational (mg) components at the horizontal position.

title: Velocity relationships
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the linear velocities (v₁ = Rω for the weight, v = 2Rω for the ball) using the no-slip condition.

title: Incorrect moment of inertia
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates the rotational kinetic energy, e.g., by using a wrong moment of inertia for the four-ball system.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answers have incorrect units, sign errors in vector components, or missing square roots/operations.

title: Free-body diagram clarity
description: Optional: Award credit if the solution includes a clear free-body diagram for the ball at position A, aiding the force analysis.
